671-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2023-4289-4518-7730.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

676-1018-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1018-1987.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1018-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1018-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2921-2946-4871-6255.notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
2921-2946-4871-6255.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2146-3532-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4184-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
4184-5686-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1069-3552-4460-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-4460-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

372-2493-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2493-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

628-2034-7189.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2919-4050-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4050-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-4785-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

803-4050-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
803-4050-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

985-5078-5231-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

4050-4766-4825-7091.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emrakul, adding {1}.
When Emrakul dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Emrakul trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Emrakul and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
4050-4766-4825-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Emrakul or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Emrakul with the returned creature for that iteration.

1251-1402-2644-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2835-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Fecundity.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Cryptic Trilobite from your library.
Repeat.

2178-3362-6542-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-6542-6798.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos

333-5617-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

914-3335-3499.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3335-3499.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-3335-3499.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-4927-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

586-1594-2921-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2510-2908-3682-5542.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-2908-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2681-2930-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
2681-2930-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Portent Tracker do not have summoning sickness.
2681-2930-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

439-3967-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Arashin Sovereign.
439-3967-4766-5683.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, causing you to put it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Arashin Sovereign and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

3605-5145-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2103-2529-4423.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

337-719-3525-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
337-719-3525-4508.description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.

1121-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight lands.
1121-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Mishchievous Quanar's morph ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, turning it face up.
Mischievous Quanar triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least eight Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mischievous Quanar's first ability by paying {3}{U}{U}, turning it face down.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and mana, which you can then use to activate Mischievous Quanar to get infinite copies of any other instant and/or sorcery spell(s) on the stack.

2816-2916-3129-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Pippin does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Pippin.
2816-2916-3129-4659.description:
Activate Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Pippin by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1651-2561-4365-4798.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, creating two Food tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil twice, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Repeat.

372-2902-3991.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2902-3991.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Journey to Nowhere until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Faceless Butcher enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Journey to Nowhere from exile to the battlefield.
Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Faceless Butcher.
Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

914-1235-2493.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1235-2493.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist and Archaeomancer with haste.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

678-3267-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Undercellar Myconid, adding {G}.
Undercellar Myconid dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Undercellar Myconid trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Undercellar Myconid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling token, adding {1}.
Cast Undercellar Myconid by paying {2}{G}.
Undercellar Myconid enters the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3490-4455-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Ghost Lantern attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one additional artifact.
3490-4455-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Ghost Lantern, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of counters on the creature with Ghost Lantern attached, you may activate its equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to any other creature you control to get infinite +1/+1 counters on all creatures you control.

678-3593-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand.
678-3593-5231.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting any creature from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing any nontoken creature you control, adding {R}.
The creature dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2024-3295-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
2024-3295-5168.description:
Activate Swirling Spriggan by paying {G/U}{G/U}, making a creature you control all colors until end of turn.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Bloom Tender +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2228-4994.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to one.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
2228-4994.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to one.
The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Hapatra and Blowfly Infestation trigger.
Resolve the Hapatra trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
Resolve the Blowfly Infestation trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to one.
Repeat from step 2.
